name: ClinGen PP3/BP4 local posterior score calibration on held-out ClinVar missense SNVs (Rewire)
description: Rewire-designed CPU calibration benchmark applying Pejaver et al. 2022 and Bergquist et al. 2025 local posterior calibration across temporally held-out ClinVar missense SNVs and non-1000G allele-frequency controls.

attributes.task: Calibrate computational variant predictor scores to ACMG/AMP PP3 and BP4 evidence strength thresholds
attributes.scope_note: Nine score tracks across eight predictors calibrated on CPU from committed variant cohorts and score tables with 1,000 stratified bootstrap resamples.
limitations: Precomputed score tables on temporally held-out ClinVar >=2-star missense SNVs; does not evaluate indels, noncoding variants or predictors absent from public lookup tables.
EVEE (Zenodo 19701997) incorporates ClinVar supervision through 2026-03-20 and has direct target exposure on post_2023_12 and post_2025_03; withheld as a leaked descriptive control.

Earlier predictors (REVEL v1.3, CADD v1.7, AlphaMissense) predate or partially overlap older ClinVar releases; only variants without prior P/LP or B/LB assertions at the cutoff date enter each holdout.

gnomAD reference calibration uses 6,312 missense SNVs (5,155 ClinVar VUS with population AF and 1,157 gnomAD missense background SNVs) to solve the prior-matched local posterior equation with gft = 0.03.

name: clingen-pp3-bp4 cohort: post_2023_12 (9450 missense SNVs)
description: 9,450 ClinVar 2026-11-08 >=2-star clean missense SNVs (5,508 P/LP, 3,942 B/LB; 4,188 novel) not classified P/LP or B/LB in clinvar_20231226.vcf.gz, calibrated with 6,312 gnomAD missense reference SNVs.

limitations: No AF cap applied; includes common benign variants removed in the post_2023_12_af001 stratum.

gnomAD reference calibration uses 6,312 missense SNVs (5,155 ClinVar VUS with population AF and 1,157 gnomAD missense background SNVs) to solve the prior-matched local posterior equation with gft = 0.03.

attributes.protocol: Excluded variants with any prior P/LP or B/LB assertion in clinvar_20231226.vcf.gz; unfiltered for allele frequency; calibrated against 6,312 population missense SNVs (gft = 0.03). Calibrated with alpha = 0.0441, c = 1124, minpoints = 100 and 1,000-bootstrap one-sided 95% conservative bounds (seed 20261123).
